title: ENS Foundation Tier B (v1)
summary: Material community grants with explicit five-surface mapping, policy pinning, and public projection expectations.

phase2Policy.notes: Phase II required only when automated evaluators materially inform recommendations.

policySourceCapture.notes: Exact-byte capture and schema 0.2 pinning required where feasible for governing-policy sources.

operatorConfirmations.description: Confirm which artifact governs each of the five decision surfaces.
Confirm whether each gate is eligibility versus merit evaluation.
Confirm evaluator participation versus roster membership.
Confirm decision authority and decision rule.
Confirm conflict status, recusal, and substitution.
Confirm whether a finding is supported fact, judgment, uncertainty, or unverified claim.
Confirm unavailable versus protected fields and redaction basis.
Confirm whether automated evaluation was materially influential.

nonGoals: No merit scoring or approve/reject recommendation engine.
No inference of eligibility without operator confirmation.
No assignment of institutional authority by the adapter.
No ENS endorsement claim from profile use alone.

burdenBudget.intent: Proportionate evidence for material community grants.
burdenBudget.notes: Expect source capture, pinning, and projection worksheets.
